ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels with approximately 15-20% high-intensity (white) pixel coverage concentrated in localized patches and streaks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dark-base pixels dominate. High-contrast white mottling cluster on the right lobe tip. Scattered white linear markings on the left lobe. Medium-intensity vertical band near the central notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped indentation; estimated angle of 55 degrees with significant pixel-depth penetration towards the peduncle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular trailing edge with frequent low-amplitude serrations. Notable high-amplitude indentations on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge leading to pointed lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-intensity white clusters at the terminal tips of both lobes; right tip shows a dense, roughly circular cluster pattern.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Visible white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks); most prominent as diagonal and vertical tracks on the left lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large vertical scar near the central notch; multiple jagged indentations on the right lobe trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense white speckling pattern isolated to the right-central region of the fluke surface.
